analyst.summary: AWL Agri Business (formerly Adani Wilmar), India's largest edible-oil player under the Fortune brand, closed FY26 with 17% revenue growth that was almost entirely price/commodity-led (volumes up just 4%), and full-year profit actually fell 15% to Rs1,045cr as margins roughly halved through the year on competitive pressure and higher input costs; the Adani-to-Wilmar promoter transition is now fully complete, removing a prior overhang, and a duty-structure tailwind protects domestic refining margins, but at ~23x earnings and 2.3x book for a ~10% ROE, thin-margin commodity business, the valuation looks to be pricing a margin-expansion and Food-and-FMCG mix-shift story that has not yet shown up in the numbers (edible oil volumes were flat in the most recent quarter); Q1 FY27 formal results are due 30-Jul-2026.
